ValidationRule.description: Ensures required fields are not null for Card Dispute cases.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Don't recognise the transaction"), OR( ISBLANK(Description), OR(ISPICKVAL(Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c, 'NA')), AND( ISPICKVAL(Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c, 'No'), OR(ISPICKVAL(Card_In_Possession_During_Transaction__c,''), ISPICKVAL(Card_In_Possession_During_Transaction__c,'NA')) ), OR(ISPICKVAL(Has_The_Card_Been_Stopped__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Has_The_Card_Been_Stopped__c, 'NA')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Description of Issue, Is The Card Lost/Stolen and Has The Card Been Stopped. If the Card In Possession During Transaction is No, then Card In Possession During Transaction is required.
